Evaluated at the proton-pinned modulus q_0 against CODATA 2022. Every cell is computed numerically, satisfying the exact product identity [9]_{q_0}[10]_{q_0} = 10.3635176 \times 11.8942752 = 123.266530, with the sub-leading row -2.1\;\mathrm{ppm}, which is the Chern-Simons tower resummed with the Gram factor \kappa set to 1 (no Gram correction at all) at the muon pin (-2.128\;\mathrm{ppm}). The row above uses the derived Witten \kappa \approx 1.7216 with the tower resummed in closed form.

The correction remains conjectural. Only the bare row is derived. The Chern-Simons correction is a conjecture whose Gram constant \kappa rests on an unproved step; exact closure at this pin would need \kappa \approx 1.9153, which differs from the Witten value by 11.2\% (Chern-Simons correction, open problems).
